title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
authors: Authors not explicitly mentioned in the provided text
abstract: This paper introduces DeepSeek-R1, a large language model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on reasoning tasks through reinforcement learning. The model is trained using a combination of cold-start data and large-scale reinforcement learning, resulting in improved reasoning capabilities and readability.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content: Imagine you're trying to solve a complex math problem. You'd break it down into smaller steps, think about each step, and then combine them to get the final answer. This is similar to how Large Language Models (LLMs) work, but instead of using supervised learning, we're using reinforcement learning to improve their reasoning capabilities. By doing so, we can create models that can think more like humans and provide more accurate and readable responses.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content: We start with a base model and apply reinforcement learning to improve its reasoning capabilities. We use a reward system that evaluates the model's responses based on accuracy and readability. The model is then fine-tuned using a combination of cold-start data and reinforcement learning. This process is repeated multiple times to achieve state-of-the-art performance on reasoning tasks.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content: Our model, DeepSeek-R1, achieves state-of-the-art performance on various reasoning benchmarks, including AIME 2024, MATH-500, and Codeforces. For example, on AIME 2024, DeepSeek-R1 achieves a score of 79.8%, outperforming other models such as OpenAI-o1-1217. On MATH-500, DeepSeek-R1 achieves a score of 97.3%, demonstrating its strong reasoning capabilities.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content: The development of DeepSeek-R1 has significant implications for the field of artificial intelligence. By achieving state-of-the-art performance on reasoning tasks, we can create models that can assist humans in a wide range of applications, from education to healthcare. Additionally, the use of reinforcement learning and cold-start data can help improve the readability and accuracy of model responses, making them more useful and trustworthy.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content: The key innovations of DeepSeek-R1 include the use of reinforcement learning to improve reasoning capabilities, the combination of cold-start data and reinforcement learning for fine-tuning, and the evaluation of model responses based on accuracy and readability. These innovations have enabled DeepSeek-R1 to achieve state-of-the-art performance on reasoning tasks and have significant implications for the field of artificial intelligence.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content: To try DeepSeek-R1 yourself, you can access the model through our API or by downloading the pre-trained model. You can use the model to generate responses to a wide range of questions and prompts, from simple math problems to complex reasoning tasks. By experimenting with DeepSeek-R1, you can see firsthand the power of reinforcement learning and cold-start data in improving reasoning capabilities.
